export interface AgentStep {
  id: string
  name: string
  role: string
  seed: string
  action: string
  note: string
  steps: string[]
  workS: number
  isError?: boolean
  errorStepIndex?: number
  errorNote?: string
}

export interface AgentFlow {
  id: 'success' | 'error'
  label: string
  taskTitle: string
  outcome: 'success' | 'error'
  agents: AgentStep[]
}

export interface AgentPreset {
  id: string
  name: string
  flows: AgentFlow[]
}
